description:
Create a GeoGebra visualization of the 'Chaos Game' fractal (Sierpinski Triangle) using three European capitals as vertices. 

1. Plot three points at these approximate coordinates:
   - London: (-0.1, 51.5)
   - Paris: (2.3, 48.9)
   - Brussels: (4.3, 50.8)
   (You will need to zoom/pan to see them).

2. Generate a fractal point cloud using the Chaos Game algorithm:
   - Start with an initial point anywhere.
   - Generate at least 500 iterations.
   - Rule: Next Point = Midpoint(Current Point, Random Vertex).
   - You can use the Spreadsheet View or the Sequence command.

3. Save the project as 'chaos_europe.ggb' in ~/Documents/GeoGebra/projects/.
